profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ InstaLILY AI | Stateful Agent Systems | Memory, Provenance, Evals & Long-Horizon Execution
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I build AI systems for problems where the architecture is not obvious yet.

I’m especially interested in memory, attention, and long-horizon reasoning: how agents preserve experience, revise state, maintain provenance, and reduce enormous spaces of possible actions into tractable decisions.

I’ve always liked puzzles, and I think about LLM behavior similarly: context, syntax, diction, memory, and prior state all shape the space of possible outputs. My approach is deliberately cross-disciplinary, drawing especially from philosophy, neuroscience, language, history, and economics to find abstractions that can become useful engineering mechanisms.

I’ve built production agent systems across orchestration, evaluation, retrieval, and data infrastructure. I’m most interested in technically difficult problems where both the architecture and the problem definition are still evolving.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead core platform initiatives for scalability of onboarding and acquisition of clients 

• Designed and built a production agent memory and action system end to end, enabling agents to reason over concrete prior experiences while maintaining episodic state, structural provenance, mutation history, and LLM-based evaluation loops. Treated memory as evolving operational state rather than static embedding retrieval, enabling traceable state changes and targeted revision of downstream state following upstream changes.

• Developed the orchestration and data infrastructure behind production AI systems, including agentic RAG, Text-to-SQL, retrieval, ETL, PostgreSQL, enterprise integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

• Hands-on contributor across multiple production codebases, including internal agent infrastructure, a customer platform serving ~1,400 active users, and internal GTM systems.

• Work directly with customers, product, sales, and executive leadership to turn ambiguous business problems into technical architectures and production system.

• Lead cross-domain teams across architecture, code review, roadmap planning, project execution, and mentorship.

positions.title: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering
positions.description:
• Owned and supervised multiple concurrent customer deployments while balancing bespoke requirements against reusable platform architecture.

• Established processes for scaling forward-deployed engineering while maintaining boundaries between customer-specific work and core platform development.

• Served as a primary engineering interface for high-priority and revenue-critical customer engagements, including executive-facing architecture and technical decision-making.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Built a regulatory-news monitoring/scraping tool to help Compliance stay current on relevant rule changes and regulatory developments.

• Worked on derivatives pricing and trading-bound analysis using Bloomberg Terminal, Excel, and SQL.

• Completed additional short-cycle projects across multiple teams, adapting quickly to unfamiliar problem domains and internal systems.

projects.title: Agentic Research & Experimental Evaluation System
projects.description:
Building an independent agentic research system testing whether LLMs can infer consequential relationships and mechanisms from ambiguous real-world events.

Designed the program around preregistered hypotheses, immutable execution-time provenance, blinded evaluation, explicit stopping criteria, and staged semantic → structural/economic → outcome gates. Experimental runs are stateful and auditable, preventing later results or protocol changes from retroactively altering what was tested.

Current work examines whether LLMs can reconstruct latent economic relationships directly from events rather than relying on static relationship graphs.

projects.title: Autonomous Robot Math Solver
projects.description: Developed a robotics project that identifies numbers and operations in handwritten math problems and writes the solution using computer vision, reverse kinematics, Python, RosPy and machine learning techniques
